Friends, presence, blocking and account recovery

Friends and block lists are durable identity relationships. Presence is an authorized projection, not a durable promise that a particular actor remains loaded. Account recovery belongs to the authentication provider/service, not an NPC or local save edit.

Scope and player interaction

Friends and block lists are durable identity relationships. Presence is an authorized projection, not a durable promise that a particular actor remains loaded. Account recovery belongs to the authentication provider/service, not an NPC or local save edit.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase19committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

ListLoading → Ready → RequestPending → Friend → Blocked → Offline → RecoveryRedirect

WBP_Social observes results from URPGSocialComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_SocialPolicy_Default. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
RelationshipOwnerId and TargetIdentityId: explicit account/character scope; default account-level privacy with character display
FriendRequestId/state/expiry; bilateral accepted relationship
BlockRecord: owner/target; precedence over private messages/invites/trade
Presence: Online|Away|Offline plus privacy-approved zone detail
RecoveryProviderId: configured account recovery route, no password stored by game UI

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGSocialComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_SocialLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
SendFriendRequest(CommandId, TargetIdentity) -> Pending|Blocked|AlreadyRelated
RespondFriendRequest(CommandId, RequestId, Accept) -> Updated|Expired
SetBlock(CommandId, TargetIdentity, IsBlocked) -> Updated
QueryPresence(FriendIds) -> PrivacyFilteredPresence
BeginAccountRecovery() -> ProviderFlow; client/auth adapter

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Player finds a character through a bounded name/identity lookup; server applies privacy and rate limits without exposing account secrets.
  2. Friend request records are authenticated and deduplicated; acceptance creates the authorized bilateral relationship.
  3. Block writes take precedence and immediately invalidate delivery/invite/trade eligibility according to policy.
  4. Presence combines active session leases and user privacy settings; it expires when a lease ends rather than persisting a stale Online flag.
  5. WBP_Social updates from service results and local notifications; actor references are resolved only for currently relevant in-zone players.
  6. Recovery opens the configured provider flow; after identity is regained, load the same durable account/characters through normal validation.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Define account-versus-character relationship semantics in DA_SocialPolicy_Default; do not mix them opportunistically across features.
  2. Create DB_social_edges, DB_social_edges and DB_social_edges with uniqueness constraints and deletion/retention policy.
  3. Build WBP_Social with requests, friends, blocked list, private-message and invite controls; blocked actions are clearly disabled.
  4. Reopen chat/party/trade to consult the same block policy rather than copied lists. Add account recovery link to WBP_Login, not a game-side password reset implementation.
  5. Test cross-zone presence and logout lease expiry with two accounts.

Reopen Phase19 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: SocialFixture_AB / Character_A / Character_B. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Duplicate request -> one request, no notification spam.
Blocked target gets invite/trade/private message -> denied by common policy.
Presence cache stale after crash -> expires; no secret zone/online disclosure beyond privacy policy.
Recover wrong provider account -> cannot access another AccountId's characters.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Proposed friend limit 100 and request TTL 7 days; retain only needed data. No public friend graph or exact location sharing by default.

Audit relationship changes and abuse-rate counters with privacy controls. Social lists support text search, keyboard navigation and localized presence states.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
